title: CF Meet Developer Platform control plane v1
description: Section 50 control-plane resources: organizations (Platform Access tenants), human workspace members and invitations, projects (Platform Access applications), environments (Platform Access environments), service accounts (read through Platform Access delegation; never credentials), commercial plan / assignment / billing-account references, immutable activity events and effective entitlements. Identity, credentials and scopes stay Platform Access's. 1.2.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): credentials (metadata only; the secret once), credential policy and quota restrictions, scope registry and grants, production-access requests / status / decisions, usage summaries, facts, limits and warnings, support profiles, entitlement overrides and the usage ingestion / reconciliation contract. 1.4.0 (ADR 0062 / 0063, CF Meet Platform Build): partner users (EndUser, EndUserList, Create/UpdateEndUserRequest), user tokens (UserTokenGrants, IssueUserTokenRequest, UpsertUserTokenRequest, UserToken, UserWithToken, RevokeSessionsResult), allowed websites (AllowedOrigins, PutAllowedOriginsRequest), push credential metadata (PushCredential(List), CreatePushCredentialRequest; secrets are write-only and sealed), production capabilities END_USERS and PUSH, usage type MESSAGE_SENT. 1.5.0 (ADR 0064 / 0065, CF Meet Apps): App, AppManifest, PutAppRequest, AppStatus, AppClientSecret (once), AppGrant(List), PutAppTestAccountsRequest, OperatorApp, AppDecisionRequest, DirectoryApp(List) and the OAuth wire shapes (snake_case): OAuthTokenRequest, OAuthRevokeRequest, OAuthToken, OAuthError, OAuthUserinfo, OAuthMetadata. 1.6.0 (ADR 0068): operator read models for the admin bridge (OperatorProject, OperatorEnvironment, OperatorMember, OperatorInvitation, OperatorPushProvider, OperatorWebhook, OperatorWebhookDelivery, OperatorAppSummary, OperatorAppVersion, OperatorAppInstallation and their lists): identifiers, names, states, counts and timestamps only.

Role.description: Part VI workspace role (Section 50 permission matrix).

id.description: The organization id IS the canonical Platform Access tenant id.

classification.description: Platform Access tenant classification (operator-controlled; GET of one organization only).

OrganizationList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

userId.description: Opaque CF Meet account id (human developer); not a Platform Access principal.

MemberList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

token.description: One-time acceptance token, returned ONLY in this response (stored as a digest; never readable again).

InvitationList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

id.description: The project id IS the canonical Platform Access application id.

ProjectList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

scopes.description: Platform Access application scope grants (Platform Access is the authority).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access environment id.

authorityStatus.description: Status reported by Platform Access (GET of one environment).

EnvironmentList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

kind.description: PRODUCTION environments are activated by the production-access workflow (Section 55).

ServiceAccountStatus.description: Platform Access service-account status. The Developer Platform suspends / resumes (ACTIVE ⇄ SUSPENDED); REVOKED is terminal and an operator decision. A non-ACTIVE service account's API credentials do not authenticate.

ServiceAccount.description: A Platform Access service account (machine identity) of one environment, read through the Developer Platform. Platform Access is its only store; API credentials (secrets) are never part of it (Section 54).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access service account id.

name.description: Stable key, unique within the environment.

ServiceAccountList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

name.description: Stable key: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter or digit; unique within the environment.

CreateServiceAccountRequest.description: Creates a service account in a SANDBOX / TEST environment (PRODUCTION is refused: production-access workflow). No credential is issued (Section 54).

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

ActivityList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

CommercialPlan.description: An immutable commercial plan version. No price exists in Part VI.

CommercialPlanList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

PlanAssignmentList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

BillingAccount.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

subject.description: Internal reads with serviceAccountId / credentialId: the caller's own (never higher) limits and levels; the top-level values stay the environment's.

Entitlements.description: Effective platform entitlements (Section 54 §10.4 precedence: organization plan, explicit operator override, stricter project plan, environment cap, service-account and credential restrictions; the most restrictive value wins and the limiting level is named). Internal reads also carry the versioned snapshot consuming services cache.

expectedVersion.description: ADR 0068 A4: admin bridge only (required there), the workspace version the change applies to.

lastAuthenticatedAt.description: Section 15 (PLT-008): when the credential last authenticated successfully, as recorded by Platform Access (debounced: may lag real use by up to 5 minutes); null when never seen since last-use tracking began.

expiringSoon.description: Section 15 (PLT-008): true when the credential stops authenticating (expiry, or the end of its rotation overlap) within 14 days — rotate it now. Null only from an older identity authority.

Credential.description: Section 54: metadata of a Platform Access API credential. Never a secret or verifier.

secret.description: The raw credential, shown exactly once (never on an idempotent replay).

secretRedacted.description: Present on an idempotent replay instead of the secret.

IssuedCredential.description: Section 54: an issued or rotated credential; the secret is returned once only.

ProductionAccessRequest.description: Section 55 production-access request: SANDBOX_READY → PRODUCTION_REQUESTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED / REJECTED → LIVE / SUSPENDED.

expectedVersion.description: ADR 0068 A3: admin bridge decisions only, the row version the decision applies to.

UsageSummary.description: Section 55: environment-scoped daily usage rollups and period totals (billing-neutral quantities).

UsageFactView.description: One immutable usage fact: safe resource reference and public dimensions only (no provider ids, rates or content).

EnvironmentLimits.description: Section 55: effective limits, current usage and remaining allowance where meaningful, and limit warnings.

SupportProfile.description: Section 57 support / incident routing metadata: member references only, no ticket content, emails or phone numbers.

expectedVersion.description: ADR 0068 A4: admin bridge only (required there), the support profile version the change applies to; 0 when the workspace has no support profile yet.
ADR 0068 A4: admin bridge only (required there), the support profile version the change applies to; 0 when the workspace has no support profile yet.

UsageFactSubmission.description: A producer's usage fact (cf_usage_facts wire format); the digest is the canonical payload digest.

OperatorOrganization.description: Section 15 (PLT-009): an organization as listed to operators (no member role; who created it and whether a rename still has to reach Platform Access).

OperatorActivityEvent.description: Section 15 (PLT-009): one operator command — an OPERATOR event of an organization's activity (scope ORGANIZATION) or a platform-level command such as a plan publication or a usage rebuild (scope PLATFORM, organizationId null).

id.description: The Platform Access principal id (kind EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL).

EndUser.description: ADR 0062: a partner user (a Platform Access principal of the credential's environment). DEACTIVATED: deleted (profile erased, id kept).

EndUserList.description: A page of partner users; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

externalId.description: The partner's opaque user id (printable ASCII, no spaces); never a phone number, tel: / sip: URI.

UpdateEndUserRequest.description: Profile changes (`null` clears) and suspension / reactivation; deletion is DELETE.

msg.description: Chat: needs `messages.read` / `messages.send` on the minting credential.

mtg.description: Meetings the user may join, with a role: needs `meetings.write`. The token's compact `{c, r}` form is accepted too.

UserTokenGrants.description: ADR 0062 user token grants; effective grants are re-intersected with the minting credential's CURRENT scopes on every verification.

externalId.description: The partner's opaque user id (printable ASCII, no spaces); never a phone number, tel: / sip: URI.

UpsertUserTokenRequest.description: Creates the user if new (idempotent on externalId), then mints a token.

token.description: The CF Meet user token, shown ONCE (`Authorization: Bearer cfut_…` on the device).

tokenRedacted.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the token is never returned again.

token.description: The CF Meet user token, shown ONCE (`Authorization: Bearer cfut_…` on the device).

tokensNotBefore.description: Tokens issued before this instant (and every device credential derived from them) no longer work.

AllowedOrigins.description: ADR 0062: an environment's allowed websites (exact origins).

PutAllowedOriginsRequest.description: The complete list (replaces it): exact `scheme://host[:port]`, lowercase host, no path, no wildcard, no explicit default port; https only, except http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 in SANDBOX / TEST.

PushCredential.description: ADR 0063: push credential METADATA. The secret (APNs .p8 key / FCM service-account JSON) is sealed to the Notification Service on receipt and never stored, logged or returned.

apnsHost.description: SANDBOX and TEST environments may only use SANDBOX.

p8.description: The APNs token signing key (.p8, PEM). Write-only.

serviceAccountJson.description: The Firebase service-account key JSON (type service_account; its project_id, when present, must equal projectId). Write-only.

CreatePushCredentialRequest.description: Uploads (replaces) the environment's credential of that provider (APNS with voip false / true, or FCM).

AppManifest.description: ADR 0064: an app manifest (normalized; every change is a new immutable version).

PutAppRequest.description: PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/app: the manifest (http://localhost redirect URIs only while DRAFT; at least one user or bot scope; event types from the install-routable families).

App.description: ADR 0064 / 0065: the app registered on a project (clientId = projectId = the Platform Access application id). The live version is what Platform Access serves: the published version, else the approved one, else the current draft.

OperatorApp.description: ADR 0065: the operator view of an app (the manifest under review and the audited review history).

AppClientSecret.description: ADR 0064: a new client secret, returned ONCE (an idempotent replay returns clientSecretRedacted instead).

AppGrant.description: ADR 0064: an installation of the app (never a CF Meet account id).

PutAppTestAccountsRequest.description: ADR 0064: the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, format checked only, at most 25).

AppDecisionRequest.description: ADR 0065: an operator app decision (reject / suspend / lift-suspension: safe reason code).

expectedVersion.description: ADR 0068 A3: admin bridge decisions only, the row version the decision applies to.

DirectoryApp.description: ADR 0065: a PUBLISHED, PUBLIC app of the directory (its published manifest).

meetingSurface.description: Whether the app has an in-meeting surface.

OAuthTokenRequest.description: RFC 6749 token request (application/x-www-form-urlencoded). Client authentication: HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) or client_id + client_secret in the body (client_secret_post), never both. PKCE (code_verifier, S256) is mandatory for authorization_code.

OAuthRevokeRequest.description: RFC 7009 revocation request (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; same client authentication as the token endpoint).

OAuthToken.description: RFC 6749 token response (snake_case). bot_token only on the first authorization-code exchange of an ORGANIZATION install with bot scopes.

OAuthUserinfo.description: The signed-in user's profile for an app: sub is pairwise per app; email only with profile:email.

OperatorProject.description: ADR 0068: a project of a workspace for operators (no description, labels or support address).

OperatorEnvironment.description: ADR 0068: an environment of a workspace's project.

OperatorMember.description: ADR 0068: a workspace membership (opaque CF Meet user id; no name or address).

OperatorInvitation.description: ADR 0068: a workspace invitation without the invitee's address or token.

OperatorPushProvider.description: ADR 0068: push credential DETAILS (provider identifiers and the credential fingerprint); the sealed credential never leaves the vault.

state.description: ADR 0068 A4: DISABLED by HQ (deleted from the vault).

version.description: The row version (the expectedVersion of partners.push-key.disable).

OperatorWebhook.description: ADR 0068: a webhook subscription: the endpoint HOST only (never the URL path or query, the signing secret or the description).

OperatorWebhookDelivery.description: ADR 0068: a webhook delivery outcome (no payload, no response body).

OperatorAppSummary.description: ADR 0068: an app in operator search results (the current manifest's name and distribution).

OperatorAppVersion.description: ADR 0068: one manifest version of an app (name and distribution only).

OperatorAppInstallation.description: ADR 0068: one installation grant of an app (targets are opaque ids; scopes are counted, not listed).

VerificationCase.description: ADR 0068 A3: one case in HQ's shared verification shape (cfmeet-admin-parallel-workplan §3.6, snake_case) plus approvals_required and partner_tenant_id.

VerificationCaseDetail.description: VerificationCase plus its decision details (PARTNER_GO_LIVE: requested / approved capabilities; APP_REVIEW: the version under review and the published version).

AdminOperationRecord.description: ADR 0068 A3 / A4: an applied admin bridge command (outcome is always APPLIED; a key never applied is 404). source_status: the case state as HQ sees it for the A3 verification decisions, otherwise the command's resulting state (as its AdminCommandResult status); source_version: the resulting row version, null for unversioned subjects (a webhook delivery retry, a usage reprocess).

AdminCommandResult.description: ADR 0068 A4: the answer of an admin bridge command: the resulting state (upper snake), the resulting row version as a string (null when the subject is unversioned) and a small closed resource (ids, states, timestamps; never an address, name, content or secret).

PushKeyDisableRequest.description: ADR 0068 A4: HQ disables a partner push credential (R3).

expectedVersion.description: ADR 0068 A4: admin bridge only (required there), the row version the change applies to.

OperatorIncident.description: ADR 0068 A4: a platform incident recorded against a workspace (reference and times only).

OperatorUsage.description: ADR 0068 A4: a workspace's metered usage of one environment and usage type over the window (quantities and counts only).

from.description: First UTC day of the window.

to.description: Last UTC day of the window.

PriceBook.description: ADR 0068 A6: a price book lineage (product line, currency, market); its effective version is its latest activation already effective.

PriceVersion.description: ADR 0068 A6: a price version (no rates). DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED → SUPERSEDED; an approval expires after 12 hours.

PriceVersionDetail.description: ADR 0068 A6: a price version with its rates and the HQ staff who drafted, submitted and approved it.

items.description: One usage type's rate (minor units): graduated tiers over the quantity beyond the included amount, at least the minimum monthly charge.

PartnerRateCard.description: ADR 0068 A6: PARTNER_PLATFORM content (one rate per usage type).

ConsumerPlanSet.description: ADR 0068 A6: CONSUMER content: CF Meet user plans (FREE required at 0 when submitted).

PriceActivation.description: ADR 0068 A6: one entry of the append-only activation history.

MarketFreeze.description: ADR 0068 A6: a market's freeze (a frozen market refuses submit, approve, schedule, activate and rollback).

PricingPlan.description: ADR 0068 A6: a CF Meet user plan of a CONSUMER lineage's effective version (FREE always listed; limits null when no version is effective).

ConsumerPlanAssignment.description: ADR 0068 A6: one CF Meet user plan assignment (append-only history; a holder never assigned is on FREE).

PlanOverride.description: ADR 0068 A6: a holder's limit override.

ChargeSimulation.description: ADR 0068 A6: an estimate (minor units of the lineage's currency; nothing is charged). Partner: lines per rate and totalMinor; CF Meet user plan: planCode, cycle and totalMinor.

FinanceUsageReport.description: ADR 0068 A6: metered usage per partner workspace and usage type over the window's UTC days, with the workspace's commercial plan code.

EstimatedChargesReport.description: ADR 0068 A6: estimated charges per partner workspace under a PARTNER_PLATFORM lineage's effective version (one currency, minor units; an estimate, never revenue, nothing charged).

PlanSpreadReport.description: ADR 0068 A6: holders per CF Meet user plan as of `asOf` (never-assigned users and organizations are on FREE and not counted) and the assignments made in the window.

PriceVersionDraftRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: expectedVersion is the price book's version; rates omitted: a copy of the effective (else latest) version.

PriceVersionCommandRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: edit (rates, DRAFT only), submit / approve / activate (expectedVersion only), reject (reasonCode, default NOT_APPROVED), schedule (effectiveFrom, more than 1 minute and at most 366 days ahead). expectedVersion is the version's row version.

PriceBookRollbackRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: expectedVersion is the price book's version; versionId a SUPERSEDED version of the book that was activated before.

expectedVersion.description: 0 when the row was never created.

MarketFreezeRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: expectedVersion is the market freeze's version (0: never frozen).

expectedVersion.description: 0 when the row was never created.

ConsumerPlanAssignRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: expectedVersion is the holder's version (0: never assigned, on FREE). The plan must exist in the CONSUMER lineage's effective version (FREE always).

expectedVersion.description: 0 when the row was never created.

PlanOverrideChangeRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: expectedVersion is the override's version (0: none yet); limits null revokes.

ChargeSimulationRequest.description: ADR 0068 A6: a usage vector (PARTNER_PLATFORM) or a plan and cycle (CONSUMER); versionId omitted: the effective version.

OwnerDelivery.description: ADR 0068 A4: an owner-delivered secret as HQ may see it — a reference only. The secret (today the one-time owner invitation of a first-party workspace) goes directly to its recipient's address as a single-use claim link, sealed for the Notification Service; never the token, the link or the address.

recipientMasked.description: First character of the local part and of the domain label, the top-level domain kept (a***@e***.com), or *** when unusual. Never the address.

deliveryState.description: PENDING: queued for the Notification Service; SENT: accepted by it; FAILED: refused by it; EXPIRED: the link expired before it could be sent. Nothing is ever resent: HQ re-issues the command.

claimState.description: The invitation the link carries: CLAIMED once the owner accepted it (single use).

FirstPartyRegistrationResource.description: ADR 0068 A4: the resource of the admin bridge's partners.workspace.register-first-party answer (AdminCommandResult.resource): the workspace (organizationId = the Platform Access tenant id), its state and version, and the owner delivery reference.

recipientMasked.description: First character of the local part and of the domain label, the top-level domain kept (a***@e***.com), or *** when unusual. Never the address.

deliveryState.description: PENDING: queued for the Notification Service; SENT: accepted by it; FAILED: refused by it; EXPIRED: the link expired before it could be sent. Nothing is ever resent: HQ re-issues the command.

claimState.description: The invitation the link carries: CLAIMED once the owner accepted it (single use).

DatasetDay.description: ADR 0068 A7: one UTC day of a dataset the admin bridge pulls (datasets.v1.json): end-of-day counts reconstructed from history; null where a metric cannot be computed (never a guessed 0). cfmeet.partners_daily: workspaces_active, workspaces_restricted, workspaces_suspended (null beyond the activity history kept), partners_live, partner_mau (null: not metered). cfmeet.apps_daily: apps_draft, apps_in_review, apps_published, apps_suspended, installs (null while the installation projection is off).
